title: Register unclaimed money and pay it to the public trustee
what: Keep a register of unclaimed moneys, and pay to the public trustee any unclaimed money not paid to its owner within a year of entry.

sources.title: Public Trustee Act 1978 (Qld)
sources.quote: accountable person shall keep and maintain a register, in the form approved by the public trustee, at the person’s principal place of business in Queensland

sources.title: Public Trustee Act 1978 (Qld)
sources.quote: All unclaimed moneys, other than unclaimed superannuation benefits or unpaid wages, which have not been paid by an accountable person to the owner thereof within 1 year after they have been or should have been entered in the register kept by the accountable person under section 100 shall be paid by such person to the public trustee
